hero.subtitle: Teaming up with premier global brands and industry leaders to drive racing performance, innovation, and global commercial reach on the world stage.

items.name: KYT HELMETS
items.description: KYT Helmets are designed and developed in Italy and manufactured in Indonesia by PT Tara Citra Kusuma. The brand is known for combining premium safety, racing technology, and innovative helmet design trusted by professional riders worldwide.

items.name: Gusto
items.description: Gusto is an international racing partner supporting the pursuit of performance, precision, and excellence across the global motorsport stage. Their partnership represents a shared commitment to competitive racing and the journey towards higher levels of motorsport.

items.name: VOYAGE EYEWEAR
items.description: Voyage Eyewear, a venture of SS Enterprises, offers premium stylish sunglasses and eyewear that combine modern fashion, comfort, and everyday performance.

items.name: CEAT
items.description: CEAT is a leading global tire manufacturer engineering high-performance motorcycle tires built for exceptional grip, durability, and track precision.

items.name: FETTLE
items.description: Fettle is a premier performance and fitness brand dedicated to supporting elite athletes with specialized recovery, physical training, and endurance solutions.

items.name: Redhills KTM
items.description: Redhills KTM represents a strong connection to KTM racing and the motorcycle racing community. Their support contributes to Johann's continued development, performance, and progression through competitive motorsport.

items.name: OGIO
items.description: OGIO designs and manufactures premium, heavy-duty gear bags, backpacks, and travel luggage engineered specifically for powersports and action sports athletes.

items.name: SPN RACING
items.description: SPN Racing is a dedicated motorsports tuning and performance engineering team providing elite track setup, technical support, and race preparation.
